tei:div.tei:p: smar shod go 'jo'i bsang gsol bzhugs so/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod sprin mkha' khyab brdal// mchod 'os rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang// gnas bdag chen po rdo rje ngang dkar rtsal// lcam mo ra 'ju lha sras rdo rje 'bar// klu rgyal mi mgon seng chen g.yu rtse dang*// seng ngu ze ze ngang pa dkar yag che// nis ra ri nag shug ra 'bo yol dang// ba thal yo ru ra sag snang sras gnyen// gla ba rkang gcig lci na stag kha ral// rkang thang zhags 'dzin 'brang rgyas dam can dang*// 'dzangs ri 'bum khe dbu khri lcags phur can// mu nu bya rgod g.yu sgron g.yu phug dang*// mo nam mched brgyad ldang sman mched bdun sogs// smra shod gnas 'dir gnyug mar gnas pa yi// lha klu bdud btsan dregs pa'i dpung gi tshogs// glo bur lhags pa'i mgron rigs thams cad kun// bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol gzi byin bskyed// bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde kun spel zhing*// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor 424)dang bcas rnams kyi// 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ces pa'ang nye bar mkho ba'i phyir padma ma ṇis so// zhus so//
